barModelProblems.title: Problem 1: Corridor Distance (Part-Whole)
barModelProblems.problemText: Jake walked 40 meters. The corridor is 100 meters long. How many meters are left?

barModelProblems.title: Problem 2: Bandage Stock (Part-Whole)
barModelProblems.problemText: The nurse had 25 bandages. She used 8 bandages. How many bandages remain?

barModelProblems.title: Problem 3: Treatment Time (Part-Whole)
barModelProblems.problemText: Tom rested for 15 minutes and applied ice for 10 minutes. What is the total treatment time?

barModelProblems.title: Problem 4: Safety Rule Compliance (Part-Whole)
barModelProblems.problemText: Class 4A has 30 students. 24 students followed safety rules. How many ran?

barModelProblems.title: Problem 5: Safety Helper Stars (Multiplication)
barModelProblems.problemText: The headmaster gave 5 safety stars to each of 4 helpers. How many stars in total?
